description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown

Women Empowerment – Mukkamaar Self-Defence Training

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown conducted Mukkamaar self-defence and training sessions at Sitaram Prakash School as part of its Women Empowerment initiative.

Throughout the month of October, sessions were conducted, one every week, by trained and experienced Mukkamaar instructors. The students are taught practical techniques and essential skills to protect and defend themselves in situations where they may need to do so.

The sessions provided the students with a valuable opportunity to build confidence, awareness and self-reliance, empowering them to face challenging situations with greater preparedness.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown is proud to support initiatives that equip young girls with knowledge and confidence, helping them become stronger, safer and more empowered individuals.

Empowerment through Skills. Confidence through Knowledge.
Together, We Create Lasting Impact.
